BUG-001.description: Port 9090 conflict preventing monitoring stack launch
BUG-001.root_cause: Previous Prometheus/Grafana instance still running, port not properly released
BUG-001.impact: Cannot start monitoring stack, no Grafana dashboard access, no Prometheus metrics
long_term_prevention: Add port conflict detection to docker-compose

BUG-002.root_cause: Using Unix-style commands in Windows PowerShell environment
BUG-002.impact: Scripts fail on Windows systems, cannot check file permissions or directory contents
resolution_commands: Replace Unix commands with PowerShell equivalents
long_term_prevention: Use Python for complex operations instead of shell scripts

BUG-003.description: JSON serialization errors causing bot crashes
BUG-003.root_cause: Bytes objects and non-serializable objects in JSON payloads
BUG-003.impact: Bot crashes after 17 seconds, no actual market making happening
resolution_commands: Convert bytes objects to hex strings before JSON serialization
Add JSON safety checks before sending payloads
long_term_prevention: Add JSON serialization safety checks to all payload creation
Add pre-commit hooks for JSON safety validation

BUG-004.description: Position tracking showing -5000 values causing wrong trading decisions
BUG-004.root_cause: Incorrect position update logic not properly handling DriftPy position data
BUG-004.impact: Bot makes wrong trading decisions based on incorrect position values
resolution_commands: Fix position update method with proper DriftUser integration
Add position anomaly detection and correction
long_term_prevention: Add position anomaly detection to all position updates
Implement automatic position reset on anomalies
Add position validation to trading decision logic

BUG-005.root_cause: Invalid message format in Swift order payload
BUG-005.impact: No order execution, bot cannot place trades
resolution_commands: Add proper error handling for 422 responses
long_term_prevention: Add 422 error handling and retry logic

BUG-006.root_cause: No reconnection logic for WebSocket connections
BUG-006.impact: Lost order reception, bot stops receiving Swift orders

BUG-007.root_cause: Unclosed connections and resources not properly cleaned up
BUG-007.impact: Performance degradation over time, eventual bot crashes
resolution_commands: Add proper resource cleanup in shutdown methods

regression_tests.coverage_requirement: 100% of open bugs must have regression tests

prevention_guards.coverage_requirement: All critical and high priority bugs must have prevention guards

monitoring.metrics: Prometheus metrics for bug prevention checks
monitoring.alerts: Immediate alerts for prevention guard failures
